title: Superwomen in Love! Honey Trap and Rapid Rabbit
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The villainess Honey Trap defeats the superheroine Rapid Rabbit, sees her face, and falls in love. Unable to kill her, Honey Trap is cast out of her evil organization, and the two women team up to fight her former colleagues while Honey Trap tries to win Rapid Rabbit's heart.
life_message: It suggests that love can turn an enemy into an ally and that people can leave a harmful past behind.
